channel.title: Blockheight
channel.description: Blockheight reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: Which Crypto Bridge Route Fits a $200 Transfer?
item.description: A $200 bridge has no universal cheapest route: chains, token choice, gas and slippage decide what arrives, so compare live net-output quotes before signing.

item.title: Manta bridge or bridge then swap: what to do with a stuck transfer
item.description: A stuck cross-chain transfer may need a status check, a retry, or a separate swap; choose a route by where the funds are and which asset you need.

item.title: XRP Ledger fixes bug that could have minted trillions
item.description: XRPL says its 3.4.1 update fixed a payment overflow that could create spendable XRP, and developers found no evidence of exploitation on public networks.

item.title: DRW and Marex complete Canton swap on tokenized iBoxx index
item.description: DRW and Marex completed a total return swap on Canton tied to a tokenized iBoxx credit index, testing on-chain trade records and valuation for OTC derivatives.

item.title: Standard Chartered launches RLUSD custody in Dubai
item.description: Standard Chartered has opened RLUSD custody for eligible institutional clients in Dubai and plans an LMAX link that would let them use tokens as trading collateral.

item.title: XRPL fixes payment bug that could have created 18 trillion XRP
item.description: XRPL's 3.4.1 patch blocks a payment overflow that could create spendable XRP; the flaw dated to 2015, and developers found no evidence of public exploitation.

item.title: Orca and Loopscale Merge as Formation to Target Frontier Finance
item.description: Orca and Loopscale will operate as Formation, combining Solana trading, credit and vault tools to finance assets in AI, energy, robotics and defense.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates with six $1 million pledges
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six $1 million commitments, as Senate crypto rules remain stalled after September's failed vote.

item.title: FCA opens crypto authorisation window until February 2027
item.description: The FCA began accepting crypto authorisation applications on 30 September, opening a five-month window before the UK’s full regime starts in October 2027.

item.title: Ledger probes CryptoBilis wallet losses as $86 million estimate circulates
item.description: Ledger is probing reports tied to reseller CryptoBilis and told recent buyers to pause setup, while the widely cited $86 million loss estimate remains unverified.

item.title: XRP Ledger discloses flaw that could mint spendable XRP
item.description: XRPL's September 25 release fixed a payment overflow that could mint spendable XRP; RippleX says it found no evidence the flaw was used on public networks.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for midterm support
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for November support, with $1 million each for six, as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto rules unresolved.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House incumbents in crypto spending push
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the Senate’s crypto market-structure bill remains stalled.

item.title: chainslist can add an EVM network to a wallet in one click
item.description: chainslist lists EVM chain IDs and RPC endpoints and lets users add a network to a wallet in one click, while checking the selected chain remains essential.

item.title: CFTC Seeks Comment on Leveraged Retail Crypto Rules
item.description: The CFTC seeks comment on a federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trades, including a tailored exchange category and a 60-day response window.

item.title: Wormhole bridge transfers: how to move tokens across chains
item.description: A wormhole bridge moves tokens between chains through a signed message; this guide explains route choice, destination addresses, token forms and transfer completion.

item.title: FinCEN withdraws $10,000 crypto wallet reporting proposal
item.description: FinCEN withdrew its dormant proposal to require reports on crypto transfers above $10,000 involving self-hosted wallets, ending a six-year rulemaking.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake says it will back 32 House candidates, including six with $1 million each, as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto policy unresolved before November’s midterms.

item.title: How to Read an Avalanche Liquidity Position NFT
item.description: An Avalanche liquidity position NFT records a pool share, price range and claim rights; read its token pair, range, liquidity and fees before changing it.

item.title: Three Checks That Limit Sandwich Risk on Destination Swaps
item.description: Destination swaps face sandwich risk when a public trade can be reordered; a firm output floor, a liquid route and private submission narrow the exposure.
